title: DECSET 1007 — Alternate scroll (wheel to arrow keys)
summary: CSI ? 1007 h enables alternate scroll: on the alternate screen, scroll wheel sends arrow keys. CSI ? 1007 l disables it.

frame.note: DEC private modes are CSI sequences with a leading '?' (0x3F) private-parameter prefix. Set = final byte 'h' (DECSET); reset = final byte 'l' (DECRST).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: a DEC private mode is a CSI sequence ending at its final byte ('h' to set, 'l' to reset).

gotchas: When enabled, scroll wheel events on the alt screen are converted to arrow key presses.
Useful for TUIs that don't handle mouse scroll events.
Supported by xterm, iTerm2, and others.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: DECSET/DECRST 1007 render as byte-exact CSI ? 1007 h/l sequences.
